meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆解书面计划、并行推进执行,并为每个步骤留下证据。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果有一份写好的计划,想让多个自动化帮手照章执行、边做边向你交代进度。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a written plan into tracked parallel agent execution.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a concrete plan and want helpers to run it in parallel with clear progress logs.

howto.what: Claude 不会亲手写代码或改文件。它读取一份书面计划，拆成小任务，把实现和检查分派给多个后台助手并行执行，自己只负责核对完成情况和记录结果；改动都在独立的工作副本里完成。
howto.when: 当你说“ulw-execute”或“start work”，或要求执行 .omo/plans 下的某个计划时触发。如果没有可执行计划，它会先用 ulw-plan 引导生成计划，再开始执行。

say.text: 用 ulw-execute 开始跑 .omo/plans 下的计划。
say.note: 它会把任务拆给后台助手，自己只验收和记录。

say.text: 还没有可执行计划，用 ulw-execute 帮我引导生成一份。
say.note: 它会先请 ulw-plan 技能产出计划，再照计划执行。

howto.what_en: Claude never writes or edits code; it orchestrates. It reads a written plan, splits work into parallel subagent tasks, and tracks verification and evidence. Work happens in task-owned worktrees.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "ulw-execute" or "start work", or ask Claude to run a plan from .omo/plans. If no executable plan exists, it bootstraps one via ulw-plan before executing.

say_en.text: Run ulw-execute to execute a plan under .omo/plans.
say_en.note: It delegates sub-tasks and only verifies and records.

say_en.text: Run ulw-execute --make-pr so each phase becomes a pull request.
say_en.note: Each phase opens a separate PR; merge only if you approve.

say_en.text: No executable plan yet; use ulw-execute to bootstrap one.
say_en.note: It asks ulw-plan to draft a plan, then executes from it.
